description: Defines the LoanScheduleModelDownPaymentPeriod class representing a specific period in a loan schedule related to down payments, including properties like period number, date, principal due, and outstanding balance, with methods for data conversion and period identification.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModelDownPaymentPeriod
classes.description: Represents a down payment period in a loan schedule, implementing LoanScheduleModelPeriod interface, with properties for period details and methods for data representation and period type identification.

methods.name: downPayment
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LoanScheduleModelDownPaymentPeriod with specified period number, date, principal due, and outstanding balance.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the period instance into a LoanSchedulePeriodData object representing down payment details.

methods.name: isRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates whether this period is a repayment period (returns false).

methods.name: isDownPaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates whether this period is a down payment period (returns true).

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns the period number.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns the principal due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns interest due, always zero.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns fee charges due, always zero.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns penalty charges due, always zero.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Method placeholder for adding loan charges, does nothing.

methods.name: isRecalculatedInterestComponent
methods.description: Indicates if interest component is recalculated (returns false).

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Placeholder for adding principal amount, does nothing.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: Placeholder for adding interest amount, does nothing.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Returns null, placeholder for loan interest recalculation details.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Placeholder method, does nothing.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Returns false, indicates EMI fixed status.

methods.name: rescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns null, placeholder for rescheduled interest portion.

methods.name: setRescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Placeholder method, does nothing.
